mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cinesquare (category_id, title, content, author_id, created_at, views, city, district) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, NOW(), 0, #{city}, #{district})
mapper.select: SELECT cs.post_id AS postId, cs.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, cs.title AS title, cs.content AS content, cs.views AS views, cs.created_at AS createdAt, cs.author_id AS authorId, cs.city AS city, cs.district AS district FROM cinesquare cs JOIN category c ON cs.category_id = c.category_id WHERE cs.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cinesquare WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND author_id = #{authorId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.post_id AS postId, c.commenter_id AS commenterId, u.nickname AS authorNickname, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM comments_cinesquare c JOIN users u ON c.commenter_id = u.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.post_id AS postId, c.commenter_id AS commenterId, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM comments_cinesquare c WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments_cinesquare (commenter_id, post_id, content) VALUES (#{commenterId}, #{postId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE cinesquare SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND like_count > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cinesquare (category_id, title, content, author_id, created_at, views, city, district, is_notice) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, NOW(), 0, #{city}, #{district}, 1)
